name: Past Due
summary: A scholar needs a missing tome from the Scarlet Monastery to study Grim Batol’s ancient Wildhammer runemasters.

sections.title: An overdue book
sections.body: A scholar is writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol. The old Dalaran library’s ledgers say Doan borrowed the tome before the Third War and never returned it. Now in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, Doan still has the book, waiting to be recovered.

faq.answer: A scholar writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol needs the book for that research.
The borrowed book is called The Lost Magic of the Runemasters.
The old Dalaran library’s ledgers say a mage named Doan borrowed the book before the Third War.
The book is in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, where Arcanist Doan is now.
The scholar is researching the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol.
